findings: G-005: mandatory slide → 页面 remains an unresolved cross-context inflection collision because current corpus also contains plural slides used both for Tour lesson pages and real presentation slide decks. The unqualified singular mandatory rule is not safe as versionless cross-surface authority for this lexical family.

G-007: mandatory Run → 运行 is a cross-surface semantic over-constraint. Current corpus contains many sentence-initial ordinary/technical verb uses such as Run a query, Run the test, and Run the command, where natural zh-CN may require contextual translations such as 执行; the Tour UI label decision cannot be globally mandatory on the bare word.

G-008: pipeline has no unified terminology decision even though current formal TRANSLATION_TERMINOLOGY authority explicitly fixes pipeline → 管道 and current Learn/Docs corpus contains data pipeline contexts. The versionless glossary must carry that existing authority.
